card.name: Inside QT interval prolongation terms
card.fires_on: The word QT, or the "-pro" in "QT-prolonging" and "QTc interval-prolongation", in cardiac warnings about heart rhythm. It fires on the piece just before the rest of the term is spelled out.

modes.label: QT before c
modes.description: The word QT right before the letter c in QTc interval.
modes.example: WARNING: ARRHYTHMIA RISK WITH CONCOMITANT USE OF<< QT>>c INTERVAL PROLONGING DRUGS

modes.label: Hyphen-pro in prolongation
modes.description: The "-pro" piece of a hyphenated QT-prolongation term, before "longation" or "longing".
